# T3

> > T3 is a consumer technology publication delivering product reviews, buying guides, and news coverage across tech, smart home, gaming, fitness, and lifestyle categories.

T3 provides expert testing and reviews of consumer electronics including smartphones (iPhone, Android), audio equipment, gaming consoles, wearables, smart home devices, and active lifestyle gear. The site features comprehensive buying guides, how-to tutorials, and breaking tech news from major brands like Apple, Google, Amazon, and Samsung.

## Key Topics

- Product reviews and testing methodology
- Consumer electronics (smartphones, audio, gaming)
- Smart home and home automation
- Wearables and fitness technology
- Apple ecosystem (iPhone, Apple Watch)
- Android devices and Google products
- Gaming (Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo Switch)
- Audio equipment and headphones
- Electric vehicles and car tech
- Kitchen and home appliances
- Running shoes and active gear
- VPN services and privacy
- Tech events coverage (MWC, IFA, Apple launches)
- Black Friday and shopping deals

## Core Coverage Areas

- [Reviews](https://t3.com/reviews): Product reviews across tech, home, active & wellness categories
- [Tech Coverage](https://t3.com/tech): Main tech hub covering AI, audio, cameras, phones, gaming & more
- [Active Coverage](https://t3.com/active): Active lifestyle coverage: fitness, cycling, wearables & outdoor gear
- [Gaming Coverage](https://t3.com/au/tech/gaming): Gaming news & reviews: Xbox, Switch 2, PlayStation & handheld consoles
- [Auto Coverage](https://t3.com/au/auto): Electric vehicles & car tech: Xiaomi, BYD, Polestar & Apple CarPlay
- [US Reviews](https://t3.com/us/reviews): US version of reviews hub for tech, home & wellness products

## News & Features

- [News](https://t3.com/news): Latest tech, lifestyle & product news across all categories
- [Tech News](https://t3.com/tech/news): Breaking tech news: Apple, Meze Audio, Oppo & gaming updates
- [Features](https://t3.com/features): Feature articles on tech, lifestyle & product guides across categories
- [Tech Events Coverage](https://t3.com/us/tech-events): Tech event coverage: MWC, IFA, Apple events & product launches
- [Home Living News](https://t3.com/us/home-living/news): Smart home, kitchen appliances & sleep tech news from Our Place, Orion
- [Running Coverage](https://t3.com/how-to/running): Running news & reviews: Adidas, Arc'teryx, Hoka shoes & tech

## Buying Guides

- [Best Smart Speakers 2026](https://t3.com/features/best-smart-speaker): Smart speaker buying guide: Amazon Echo, Google Nest & Apple HomePod
- [Best VPN Services 2026](https://t3.com/features/best-vpn): Top 10 VPN buying guide with reviews, comparisons & testing methodology
- [Best 43-inch TVs 2026](https://t3.com/features/best-43-inch-TVs): Best small TV buying guide: 42-43 inch models at all price points
- [Best Google Fit Gadgets 2025](https://t3.com/features/the-best-gadgets-that-work-with-google-fit): Google Fit compatible gadgets buying guide featuring Fitbit devices
- [Best Black Friday Deals 2025](https://t3.com/us/shopping/best-black-friday-deals-2025-sales-now-on): Black Friday 2025 deals roundup: TVs, headphones, laptops & more

- [How to Connect Echo Dot to Smart Home Devices](https://t3.com/home-living/smart-home/t3-answers-how-to-connect-your-echo-dot-to-other-smart-home-devices): Echo Dot setup guide for connecting smart home devices
